description: Single and two storey side extension, Single storey rear infill extension, Alterations to roof to form hipped roof and reduced rear dormer, Relocation of roof light from front to side roof slope (Demolition of attached garage)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>KD/EXT/PP/51/25/P-110.2 R3.2&nbsp; - Existing Ground Floor, First Floor, Loft, and Roof Plans; KD/EXT/PP/51/25/P-110.3 R3.2&nbsp; - Existing Elevations, and Location Plan;&nbsp; KD/EXT/PP/51/25/P-110.4 R3.2&nbsp; - Proposed Ground Floor and First Floor Plans; KD/EXT/PP/51/25/P-110.5 R3.2&nbsp; - Proposed Loft and Roof Plans; KD/EXT/PP/51/25/P-110.6 R3.2&nbsp; - Proposed Elevations; KD/EXT/PP/51/25/P-110.7 R3.3&nbsp; - [Proposed] Block Plan; Fire Safety – Reasonable Exception Statement</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in any side elevation at first floor level, or at ground floor on the side boundary with 45 Parkside Way of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>

<p>The hereby approved roof reconfiguration to a hipped design and demolition of some existing features, including parts of the rear roof dormer, shall be fully implemented as shown approved plans prior to occupation of the floorspace hereby approved.&nbsp;</p>
